section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1994
title: PROFILE OF FATALITIES

columns.name: Death or in other words, the end of a life is an inevitable and tragic phenomenon, also a reality to be accepted by one and all. All those who are born on this earth have to depart from this mortal world some day. The deaths, in general, occur naturally as per the expectancy of life computed in any given country. Nevertheless, cases of unexpected or inopportune deaths do also get reported simultaneously. These inopportune deaths are caused by incidents, accidents or negligences (e.g. natural calamity, accident, suicide etc.). This should call for a study of the causes, avoidable as they are and remove them in the fond hope of saving as many lives as To prepare this report data was available only, on deaths due to accidents and suicides and these have been grouped as inopportune deaths. SHARE OF INOPPORTUNE CASUALTIES IN TOTAL MORTALITY IN THE COUNTRY The table below presents the proportion of Inopportune deaths in Total deaths of the country during last two and half decades.
